prompt: Pick one AI feature from your Module 1 list. What were its training examples, who might have labelled them, and which users or situations might be missing from that data?

criteria.label: Describes training examples
criteria.look_for: what the training examples probably were

criteria.label: Says who labelled them
criteria.look_for: who might have produced the labels

criteria.label: Names a missing group or situation
criteria.look_for: a specific kind of user or situation likely under-represented, and why it matters

reference: Voice assistant: its training examples were recordings of people speaking commands, labelled with the words that were said, probably by paid transcribers. Speakers with strong regional or non-native accents, children, and noisy environments may be missing, so it may work worse for them.
